UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile, assistant preferences, and persistent conversation memory summary for HAYAT AI.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: Display name shown in greetings and user profile.

voiceEnabled.description: Whether HAYAT speaks replies via Text-to-Speech.

backgroundAssistantEnabled.description: Whether the background foreground assistant service is enabled.

cityName.description: City name used for real-time weather dashboard.

memorySummary.description: Concise user preferences and context remembered across sessions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was last updated.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A single message turn in the user's persistent HAYAT AI conversation memory.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message owner.

actionTag.description: Optional phone action or mode tag executed with this turn.

hasImage.description: Whether this turn included a photo attachment.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when message was saved.

AssistantReminder.title: AssistantReminder
AssistantReminder.description: User reminder, alarm note, or study task managed by HAYAT AI.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the reminder owner.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile, settings, and assistant memory.

/users/{userId}/messages/{messageId}.description: User-scoped conversation history and memory turns.

/users/{userId}/reminders/{reminderId}.description: User-scoped reminders, alarms, and study items.
